- 12 additional graduation credits are required for foreign, Hong Kong, and Macau students whose graduating grades and schools are equivalent to Taiwan's second year of senior high school. [1]
- Military training and physical education do not count toward these 12 additional credits. [1]
- Military training and physical education are not included in the 12 additional graduation credits. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- In the first year, you must take at least 16 credits each semester. [1]
- In the second year, you must take at least 16 credits each semester. [1]
- In the third year, you must take at least 9 credits each semester. [1]
- In the fourth year, you must take at least 9 credits each semester. [1]

- International students must take the full‑year 5‑credit course “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” instead of the Chinese (B) course. [1]
- The course does not count toward the 3 credits for Chinese (A) and 2 credits for Chinese (B). [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Take 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center instead of the freshman Chinese course. [1]

- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 for assistance. [1]

- Physical education is required for five semesters (大一體育上下學期加三學期興趣選課). [2]
- It carries no graduation credits, and you cannot repeat an elective with the same title. [2]
- After the five semesters you may take a 1-credit PE course, which also does not count toward graduation. [2]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 for more information. [2]

- A master's degree needs at least 24 credits, not counting thesis credits. [1]
- You must also take at least one graduate course of 1 credit or more at NCU (waived courses do not count). [1]
- The graduation rules are set by each department, but the requirement is stated in National Central University Study Regulations, Article 58. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Students admitted directly into a doctoral program need at least 34 credits, of which at least 18 are doctoral-level, not counting dissertation credits. [1]
- The requirement is stated in Article 58 of the National Central University Study Regulations. [1]
- For more information, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]
